messages.content: "你能幫我做幾個計算嗎？首先，我想知道一位名叫馬格努斯·卡爾森的玩家目前的古典國際象棋等級。其次，我有一個二次方程式 2x² - 3x + 1 = 0，我很難解，你能幫我找出根嗎？最後，我5年前投資了一筆錢。當初的價值是5000美元，現在變成了8000美元。你能幫我計算一下年複合增長率（CAGR）嗎？"

function.name: calculate_cagr
function.description: Calculate the Compound Annual Growth Rate (CAGR) given an initial investment value, a final investment value, and the number of years. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

period_in_years.description: The period of the investment in years.

function.name: chess_rating
function.description: Fetches the current chess rating of a given player Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

player_name.description: The full name of the chess player.

variant.description: The variant of chess for which rating is requested (e.g., 'classical', 'blitz', 'bullet'). Default is 'classical'.

function.name: solve_quadratic
function.description: Find the roots of a quadratic equation. Returns both roots. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.
